method: Every final page rendered with Poppler at 125 dpi and individually viewed as page PNGs after the final build.

pages.finding: Title, subtitle, author accents, 3 November edition date, abstract and analytical-review attribution fit cleanly.
Carrier, tent, regularity and storage equations readable; equation numbers clear of text and footer.
Strong/mild and point-trace qualifications visible; input chain and characteristic signs readable; recurrence statement intact.
Recurrence and throughput proofs, net/gross distinction and zero-stock denominator qualification readable.
Preparation comparison, time dimension and two cut signs clean; complementary proposition moved to next page to keep its statement together.
Complete complementary-arc statement and proof clear; dimensional table begins legibly with no clipped row.
Table continuation repeats header; hypothetical ledger, ratio restrictions and both account-level witnesses legible.
Internal balances and per-pass hypotheses readable; unloaded C6 integrals fit within margins.
C6 proof, exact-point-versus-region qualification, patch dictionary and broken-boundary distinctions clear.
Native inherited account and decoder readable; complete dependency paragraph precedes table with no sentence interruption.
Five conclusion categories, optional-review disclosure and reproducibility/attribution clear.
All six bibliography entries legible; immutable and relative links present, no unresolved citation or clipping.

result: PASS: no clipping, collisions, missing glyphs, unreadable tables or unresolved references found. Table 1 continuation is deliberate; final images retained in external closeout.
